acceptanceFindings: submit preserves exact idempotent replay, rejects changed reuse of an idempotency key, and rejects a duplicate workId under another key with WORK_ID_CONFLICT.

safeList rejects duplicate persisted work IDs before submit or dispatch, and runDue applies dispatch outcomes only to the selected positional indexes, so an outcome cannot mutate an out-of-batch or future record.

runDue accepts only an empty request object and obtains eligibility time from the captured clock callable; a caller-supplied far-future timestamp is rejected and invalid or throwing clock output returns CLOCK_UNAVAILABLE.

Construction binds the validated clock, storage, and dispatcher callables and clones/freezes limits; replacement or mutation of the caller's exposed port properties after construction does not redefine the module's trusted interface.

Every dispatcher item carries workId and idempotencyKey, while documentation explicitly records dispatch-before-persist as an at-least-once Tier-0/shadow limitation requiring a future separately governed transactional outbox or equivalent production boundary.

Malformed requests, hostile adapter values, persistence failures, backpressure, retry bounds, unavailable providers, and invalid persistence state remain deterministic fail-closed decisions without infrastructure imports or production authority.
